name: Seeed XIAO RP2040
notes: A bare Seeed XIAO RP2040, with nothing assigned. It is a module a blaster is built around, so this preset claims no pins: a blaster config saved on it brings that blaster's wiring with it.
The module brings out GPIO 0-4, 6, 7 and 26-29, as D0-D10. Only 26-29 (A0-A3) read analog, so a battery divider or a speed pot goes on one of those.
